goal: Открываю счёт и банковскую карту в банке. Я студент, приехал учиться на год

scenes.brief:
Situation: In a bank branch, the learner is opening a bank account for the first time after arriving to study for one year. They need a basic student account and may also want a bank card.
Learner: the learner is a student. Partner: the partner is a bank clerk.
Learner must be able to: say they want to open an account; explain they are a student staying for a year; show or mention key documents such as passport, visa, proof of address, or student letter; ask about account type, card, and basic fees.
Partner will: ask why the learner needs the account and how long they will stay; ask for documents and personal details; explain the available account type and main conditions.
Not in this scene: activating the card, setting a PIN, online banking, reporting problems after opening the account.

Situation: In the same bank branch, after the account is approved, the learner asks about getting and using a bank card during their one-year study stay. This is a separate interaction focused on the card and first steps.
Learner: the learner is a student. Partner: the partner is a bank clerk.
Learner must be able to: ask when and how the card will arrive; understand whether it is given now or sent by mail; ask how to activate the card and get or choose a PIN; ask about using the mobile app and cash withdrawal.
Partner will: explain the delivery time or in-branch issue process; give simple instructions for activation, PIN, and first use; mention limits, ATM use, or app registration.
Not in this scene: opening the account, giving personal details, document check, comparing account types, fees for the account itself.

findings.detail: «I need it for ___.» leans on «it», and nothing in the frame is what it stands for
the right option «How long the learner will remain» repeats «how long» of the partner's line
«monthly fee» is not in frame p8 or its fillers
«Вам нужно мою визу?» («Вам нужно ___?» with «мою визу») does not read as Russian, the seam judge says

topic.description_target: Open a basic student account at a bank branch and ask about a card and fees.
topic.description_native: Откройте базовый студенческий счёт в отделении банка и спросите о карте и комиссиях.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Hello. How can I help you today?
messages.text_native: Здравствуйте. Чем я могу вам помочь сегодня?

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I’d like to open a student account.
messages.pronunciation_native: Айд лайк ту оупэн э стьюдэнт экаунт.
simplified_variants: I want to open a student account.

check.text_target: What does the bank clerk offer to do?
check.explanation_native: Сотрудница банка спрашивает, чем она может помочь сегодня.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: What do you need the account for?

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: I need it for my studies.
messages.pronunciation_native: Ай нид ит фор май стадиз.

check.text_target: What does the clerk ask about?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: How long will you stay here?

check.text_target: What time period does the clerk ask about?

options.text_target: How long the learner will remain

check.text_target: Which document does the clerk ask to see?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: I also need your visa and proof of address.
messages.text_native: Мне также нужны ваша виза и подтверждение адреса.

check.text_target: What two things does the clerk say she needs?
check.text_native: Какие две вещи говорит, что ей нужны, сотрудница?

options.text_target: Travel insurance and a train ticket

check.explanation_native: Сотрудница говорит, что ей нужны виза и подтверждение адреса.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Do you need a student letter?
messages.text_native: Вам нужно письмо из учебного заведения?
messages.pronunciation_native: Ду ю нид э стьюдэнт летэр?
simplified_variants: Do you need my student letter?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Yes, please. I need it for the student account.
messages.text_native: Да, пожалуйста. Оно нужно для студенческого счёта.

check.text_target: Why does the clerk need that letter?

options.text_target: To check the student account type

check.explanation_native: Письмо нужно для оформления студенческого счёта.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Can I get a bank card?
messages.pronunciation_native: Кэн ай гет э бэнк кард?

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Yes. A debit card comes with this account.
messages.text_native: Да. К этому счёту идёт дебетовая карта.

check.text_target: What kind of card comes with the account?
check.text_native: Какая карта идёт к этому счёту?
check.explanation_native: Сотрудница говорит, что к счёту идёт дебетовая карта.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: No. This student account has no monthly fee.
messages.text_native: Нет. У этого студенческого счёта нет ежемесячной комиссии.

check.text_target: What does the clerk say about regular charges?
check.text_native: Что сотрудница говорит о регулярных списаниях?

options.text_target: They are not charged each month
They are taken once a week
They are paid in cash today

check.explanation_native: Сотрудница говорит, что ежемесячной комиссии нет.

questions.explanation_native: Студент говорит, что хочет открыть студенческий счёт.
Студент говорит, что останется на один год.

questions.text_native: Какой документ сотрудница просит дополнительно к паспорту?
questions.explanation_native: Сотрудница говорит, что ей нужна виза.
Сотрудница объясняет, что к этому счёту идёт дебетовая карта.

questions.text_native: Что сотрудница говорит о ежемесячной комиссии?
questions.explanation_native: Сотрудница говорит, что ежемесячной комиссии нет.
